what_to_detect: A loyalty ability's activation whose total cost combines its loyalty cost with an additional loyalty cost from another effect: the cost half holds one loyalty counter_change of the net amount (none when they cancel), differing from the printed loyalty cost.
near_miss: A loyalty ability's activation whose loyalty counter_change equals its printed loyalty cost.
record_fields: acting line script text Cost$ AddCounter/SubCounter LOYALTY

what_to_detect: A loyalty ability's cost half holds a counter_change of loyalty counters on its source: the cost puts on or removes the loyalty counters its loyalty symbol shows.
near_miss: A loyalty ability with a cost of 0 changes no loyalty counters; without api the family does not count this side.
record_fields: a cost half's loyalty-counter cost: gen-2 cost halves record no counters (payload.costs has mana, tapped, life, sacrificed, discarded, exiled only)
